props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// Sphere of Annihilation - Sequencer + ONI Pseudo (Step In/Out)

//

// Requirements:

// - Sequencer active

// - game.ONI.pseudo.play available

//

// Sound sync (Sequencer-only):

// - Sphere VFX spawn = Darkness3.ogg

// - Sphere VFX despawn = Damage5.ogg

//

// Notes:

// - Damage sound is timed to the END of the Sphere effect (when it despawns)

// - oni:animationEnd is emitted AFTER the caster finishes returning (pipeline-safe)

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][SphereOfAnnihilation]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API not found (game.ONI.pseudo.play).");

console.error(TAG, "Missing game.ONI.pseudo.play");

return;

}

// --- Ensure ONI.emit exists (pipeline-friendly) ---

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// --- Payload ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

// --- Helpers ---

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

// --- Resolve caster & targets ---

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("SphereOfAnnihilation: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("SphereOfAnnihilation: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

const targetToken = targets[0];

// --- Disposition rule (your standard) ---

const casterDisposition =

sourceToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

sourceToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

// If enemy (-1) => move RIGHT, else LEFT

const moveRight = casterDisposition === -1;

const squares = 0.35;

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

const dx = moveRight ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx;

// --- Timings ---

const moveMs = 350;

const bufferToVfxMs = 50;

const vfxScaleInMs = 400;

const vfxHoldMs = 3000;

const vfxFadeOutMs = 500;

const vfxTotalMs = vfxScaleInMs + vfxHoldMs + vfxFadeOutMs; // 3900ms

// Pseudo hold window (starts AFTER step-out completes)

const holdMs = bufferToVfxMs + vfxTotalMs;

// --- Assets ---

const VFX_FILE =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Item/SphereOfAnnihilation_01_Regular_Purple_200x200.webm";

const SFX_SPHERE =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness3.ogg";

const SFX_DESPAWN =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage5.ogg";

// --- Broadcast start ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "sphereOfAnnihilation",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// PSEUDO: step out -> hold -> step back (continuous; no snap flash)

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function animateXY(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs, easeFn) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = (easeFn ?? easeInOutCubic)(t);

obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;

obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

const dx = Number(params.dx ?? 0);

const moveMs = Number(params.moveMs ?? 350);

const holdMs = Number(params.holdMs ?? 0);

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

// Hide real token locally once

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const homeX = sprite.x, homeY = sprite.y;

const outX = homeX + dx, outY = homeY;

await animateXY(sprite, homeX, homeY, outX, outY, moveMs, easeInOutCubic);

if (holdMs > 0) await wait(holdMs);

await animateXY(sprite, outX, outY, homeX, homeY, moveMs, easeInOutCubic);

} finally {

if (sprite) { canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite); sprite.destroy(); }

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.sphereOfAnnihilation.stepHoldBack",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: { dx, moveMs, holdMs },

meta: { source: "SphereOfAnnihilation" },

});

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// SEQUENCER: VFX + SFX timeline (Sequencer plays BOTH sounds)

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const seq = new Sequence();

// Wait until caster finishes step-out, then spawn sphere

seq.wait(moveMs + bufferToVfxMs);

// Sphere spawn sound (sync with sphere appearing)

seq.sound().file(SFX_SPHERE).volume(0.95);

// Sphere effect (scale in, hold, fade out)

seq.effect()

.file(VFX_FILE)

.atLocation(targetToken)

.scale(1.5)

.scaleIn(0, vfxScaleInMs, { ease: "easeOutCubic" })

.duration(vfxTotalMs)

.fadeOut(vfxFadeOutMs, { ease: "easeOutQuint", delay: -vfxFadeOutMs });

// Sphere despawn sound (sync with effect END)

// We schedule it relative to the moment the effect starts (right now in the timeline)

seq.sound().file(SFX_DESPAWN).delay(vfxTotalMs).volume(0.95);

// Wait until caster has time to finish returning before we end the cinematic

// (Return starts when hold ends, which matches vfxTotalMs window)

seq.wait(vfxTotalMs + moveMs + 50);

await seq.play();

// --- Broadcast end (after return is done) ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "sphereOfAnnihilation",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END", { moveMs, holdMs, vfxTotalMs });

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

// Still emit animationEnd so pipeline won't hang

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "sphereOfAnnihilation", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();

// ============================================================================

// Custom Logic - Action : Omega

// Bonus damage = + ceil(targetLevel / 2)

// Target level path: targetToken.actor.system.props.level

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][OMEGA][+HALF-TARGET-LVL]";

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

// Get first target (Omega is "One creature")

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0];

if (!firstTargetUuid) return console.warn(TAG, "No target UUID found. Bonus not applied.");

// Resolve target doc -> token/actor

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetToken = targetDoc?.object ?? targetDoc; // TokenDocument -> Token if available

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc; // Token -> Actor, or Actor directly

// Read level (prefer token actor, fallback to actor)

const lvlRaw =

targetToken?.actor?.system?.props?.level ??

targetActor?.system?.props?.level ??

0;

const level = Math.max(0, parseInt(String(lvlRaw), 10) || 0);

// Half, always round up

const bonus = Math.ceil(level / 2);

// Apply as bonus damage in advPayload

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const before = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = before + bonus;

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

target: targetActor?.name,

level,

bonusAdded: bonus,

bonusBefore: before,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});

})();

props.animation_script:
(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][RunFront-SFX-Return]";

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const DEBUG = true;

const SOUND_SRC = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_manto.wav";

const SOUND_VOLUME = 0.5;

const MOVE_OUT_MS = 320;

const HOLD_MS = 1500; // wait after SFX before running back

const MOVE_BACK_MS = 320;

const APPROACH_GAP = 70;

function dbg(...args) {

if (!DEBUG) return;

console.log(TAG, ...args);

}

function warn(...args) {

console.warn(TAG, ...args);

}

function err(...args) {

console.error(TAG, ...args);

}

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, eventPayload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, eventPayload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload: eventPayload });

};

}

async function toTokenPlaceable(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (typeof ref === "string") {

const byId = canvas.tokens?.get(ref);

if (byId) return byId;

try {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

return doc.object ?? doc.token?.object ?? doc;

} catch (e) {

warn("toTokenPlaceable failed fromUuid:", ref, e);

return null;

}

}

return ref.object ?? ref.token?.object ?? ref ?? null;

}

function uniq(arr) {

return [...new Set(arr.filter(Boolean))];

}

function summarizeToken(tok) {

if (!tok) return null;

return {

id: tok.id ?? null,

name: tok.name ?? tok.document?.name ?? null,

uuid: tok.document?.uuid ?? null,

center: tok.center ? { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y } : null,

x: tok.x ?? null,

y: tok.y ?? null

};

}

async function resolveSourceToken() {

const candidates = [

payload.casterTokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenUuid,

payload.performerTokenUuid,

payload.tokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenId,

payload.casterTokenId,

globalThis._token?.document?.uuid,

globalThis.token?.document?.uuid

];

dbg("resolveSourceToken candidates:", candidates);

for (const c of candidates) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return canvas.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

async function resolveTargetTokens() {

const raw = uniq([

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetTokenUuids) ? payload.targetTokenUuids : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetUUIDs) ? payload.targetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.originalTargetUUIDs) ? payload.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targets) ? payload.targets : []),

...(Array.from(game.user?.targets ?? []).map(t => t?.document?.uuid))

]);

dbg("resolveTargetTokens raw refs:", raw);

const out = [];

for (const r of raw) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(r);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

return out;

}

let resolvedSourceToken = null;

let resolvedTargets = [];

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

const sourceToken = await resolveSourceToken();

const targets = await resolveTargetTokens();

const firstTarget = targets[0] ?? null;

resolvedSourceToken = sourceToken;

resolvedTargets = targets;

dbg("Resolved source token:", summarizeToken(sourceToken));

dbg("Resolved targets:", targets.map(summarizeToken));

dbg("Payload snapshot:", payload);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found.");

return;

}

if (!firstTarget) {

ui.notifications.warn("No target token found.");

return;

}

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

function getNativeFlipX(token) {

const values = [

token?.document?.texture?.scaleX,

token?.mesh?.scale?.x,

token?.icon?.scale?.x

].filter(v => typeof v === "number");

if (values.some(v => v < 0)) return true;

const mirrorX = token?.document?.texture?.mirrorX;

if (typeof mirrorX === "boolean") return mirrorX;

return false;

}

function setSpriteFlipX(sprite, flipped) {

const sx = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x || 1);

sprite.scale.x = flipped ? -sx : sx;

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

const home = { x: token.center.x, y: token.center.y };

sprite.x = home.x;

sprite.y = home.y;

if (baseObj) {

sprite.width = Math.abs(baseObj.width);

sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height);

sprite.alpha = baseObj.worldAlpha ?? 1;

sprite.rotation = baseObj.rotation ?? 0;

}

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zIndex ?? 5000);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, getNativeFlipX(token));

return sprite;

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

const originalFlipX = getNativeFlipX(casterToken);

const home = { x: casterToken.center.x, y: casterToken.center.y };

const target = targetTokens?.[0] ?? null;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

let front = {

x: home.x + Number(params.fallbackDx ?? -120),

y: home.y

};

if (target) {

const targetCenter = target.center ?? { x: home.x, y: home.y };

const approachDir = home.x >= targetCenter.x ? 1 : -1;

const gap = Number(

params.approachGap ??

Math.max(casterToken.w ?? 100, target.w ?? 100) * 0.6

);

front = {

x: targetCenter.x + (approachDir * gap),

y: targetCenter.y

};

}

// Run in

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, originalFlipX);

await animateXY(

sprite,

home,

front,

Number(params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

// Hold while the external SFX window plays

if (Number(params.holdMs ?? 0) > 0) {

await wait(Number(params.holdMs ?? 0));

}

// Flip for the run back

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, !originalFlipX);

await animateXY(

sprite,

front,

home,

Number(params.moveBackMs ?? params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

} finally {

if (sprite) {

canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);

sprite.destroy();

}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

dbg("Starting pseudo movement session.");

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn.flipAware",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [firstTarget.document.uuid],

params: {

moveOutMs: MOVE_OUT_MS,

holdMs: HOLD_MS,

moveBackMs: MOVE_BACK_MS,

approachGap: APPROACH_GAP,

fallbackDx: sourceToken.center.x >= firstTarget.center.x ? -120 : 120,

zIndex: 5000

},

meta: {

source: "RunFrontSfxReturn",

soundSrc: SOUND_SRC

}

});

// Sequencer handles SFX only.

dbg("Starting Sequencer SFX.");

const sfxSeq = new Sequence();

sfxSeq

.wait(MOVE_OUT_MS)

.sound()

.file(SOUND_SRC)

.volume(SOUND_VOLUME);

sfxSeq.play();

// Wait for the whole cinematic window before ending.

await wait(MOVE_OUT_MS + HOLD_MS + MOVE_BACK_MS + 80);

dbg("Animation wait window finished.");

} catch (e) {

err("Animation crashed:", e);

} finally {

try {

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

dbg("Emitted oni:animationEnd.", {

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id)

});

} catch (e) {

err("Failed to emit animationEnd:", e);

}

}

})();

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][AUTOHIT_IF_TARGET_SLOW]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0] ?? null;

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "No target UUID found in __PAYLOAD.targets.");

return;

}

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve target actor.", { firstTargetUuid });

return;

}

const EXACT_ACTOR_EFFECT_UUID = "Actor.uJFaNQCSvwwsr2AW.ActiveEffect.I3fIlZpKot7yK6mS";

const SOURCE_EFFECT_UUID = "Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.h3M2iAUzB26A4zNo";

const SLOW_NAME = "slow";

const effects = targetActor.effects?.contents ?? [];

const hasSlow = effects.some((effect) => {

const effectUuid = String(effect?.uuid ?? "").trim();

const origin = String(effect?.origin ?? "").trim();

const sourceId = String(effect?.flags?.core?.sourceId ?? "").trim();

const name = String(effect?.name ?? effect?.label ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

return (

effectUuid === EXACT_ACTOR_EFFECT_UUID ||

effectUuid === SOURCE_EFFECT_UUID ||

origin === SOURCE_EFFECT_UUID ||

sourceId === SOURCE_EFFECT_UUID ||

name === SLOW_NAME

);

});

if (!hasSlow) {

console.log(TAG, "Target is not inflicted with Slow. No auto-hit applied.", {

target: targetActor.name,

checkedEffects: effects.map(e => ({

name: e?.name ?? e?.label ?? "",

uuid: e?.uuid ?? "",

origin: e?.origin ?? "",

sourceId: e?.flags?.core?.sourceId ?? ""

}))

});

return;

}

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

p.accuracy = p.accuracy || {};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const beforeCheckBonus = Number(p.accuracy.checkBonus ?? 0) || 0;

const beforeTotal = Number(p.accuracy.total ?? 0);

// Per your request: grant +99 accuracy bonus

p.accuracy.checkBonus = beforeCheckBonus + 99;

// Also raise the already-computed total, since Action custom logic runs

// after ActionDataComputation in your pipeline.

if (Number.isFinite(beforeTotal)) {

p.accuracy.total = beforeTotal + 99;

}

// Safety flags for later hit logic

p.advPayload.autoHit = true;

p.meta.autoHitBySlow = true;

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

target: targetActor.name,

matchedBy: effects.map(e => ({

name: e?.name ?? e?.label ?? "",

uuid: e?.uuid ?? "",

origin: e?.origin ?? "",

sourceId: e?.flags?.core?.sourceId ?? ""

})),

checkBonusBefore: beforeCheckBonus,

checkBonusAfter: p.accuracy.checkBonus,

totalBefore: beforeTotal,

totalAfter: p.accuracy.total,

autoHit: p.advPayload.autoHit

});
props.custom_logic_resolution:
const TAG = "[CL-RES][IP-DRAIN-2]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? p?.__confirmArgs ?? {};

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const userActor = await context.helpers.getAttackerActor();

if (!userActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing user actor.");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found.");

return;

}

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args?.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

const escapeHTML = foundry?.utils?.escapeHTML ?? ((v) => String(v ?? ""));

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= targetDef;

};

const getUserTokenName = () => {

if (typeof _token !== "undefined" && _token?.name) return _token.name;

return userActor?.name ?? "User";

};

const getTargetDisplayName = (targetDoc, targetActor) => {

return targetDoc?.name ?? targetActor?.name ?? "Target";

};

async function postStealFeedbackHtml(innerHtml) {

const FLAG_SCOPE = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const FLAG_KEY = "oniHideChatHeader";

let hookId = null;

hookId = Hooks.on("renderChatMessage", (message, html) => {

if (!message?.getFlag?.(FLAG_SCOPE, FLAG_KEY)) return;

html.find(".message-header").remove();

html.find(".message-sender").remove();

html.find(".message-metadata").remove();

html.find(".message-avatar").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-container").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-message-portrait").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-image").remove();

html.find("img.chat-portrait").remove();

Hooks.off("renderChatMessage", hookId);

});

await ChatMessage.create({

user: game.user.id,

type: CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPES.OTHER,

speaker: { alias: "" },

content: `

${innerHtml}

`,

flags: {

[FLAG_SCOPE]: {

[FLAG_KEY]: true

}

}

});

}

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const userTokenName = getUserTokenName();

const targetName = getTargetDisplayName(targetDoc, targetActor);

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

const hit = isHit(targetUuid, targetActor);

console.log(TAG, "HIT CHECK", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

accTotal,

hasAccuracy,

autoHit,

targetDef,

hit

});

if (!hit) {

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(targetActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userMaxIp = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.max_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const requestedSteal = 2;

// The steal amount depends only on the target's current IP.

// Even if the user is already at max IP, the target still loses IP.

const actualSteal = Math.min(requestedSteal, targetIpBefore);

if (actualSteal <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No IP stolen", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

targetIpBefore,

userIpBefore,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpAfter = Math.max(0, targetIpBefore - actualSteal);

// User gain is clamped by max IP, but does not affect the steal amount.

const actualGain = Math.min(actualSteal, Math.max(0, userMaxIp - userIpBefore));

const userIpAfter = Math.min(userMaxIp, userIpBefore + actualGain);

await targetActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(targetIpAfter)

});

await userActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(userIpAfter)

});

console.log(TAG, "IP TRANSFER APPLIED", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

actualSteal,

actualGain,

targetIpBefore,

targetIpAfter,

userIpBefore,

userIpAfter,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(

`${escapeHTML(userTokenName)} steals ${escapeHTML(actualSteal)} IP from ${escapeHTML(targetName)}!`

);

}
